algorithm.nochatreports.aes_cfb8_base64:
§lAES/CFB8+Base64R§r
Standard symmetric encryption algorithm. Uses 128 bit keys, output is encoded in a special version of Base64 to permit transfer via Minecraft's chat. As a downside - messages will gain roughly 30% increase in length and the server might truncate them if they exceed the size limit.
algorithm.nochatreports.aes_ecb_base64:
§lAES/ECB+Base64R§r
Considerably less secure than CFB mode, but saves you some bytes by not requiring the initialization vector. Still beats Caesar.
algorithm.nochatreports.aes_gcm_base64:
§lAES/GCM+Base64R§r
More security in exchange for a severe increase in message size (12 bytes for the initialization vector and 12 bytes for the authentication tag, Base64 encoding on top). Choose this if you value security over anything else.
algorithm.nochatreports.caesar:
§lCaesar§r
Meme cipher. With this you're basically hoping that people will give up without even trying to decrypt your messages. That might be true in many cases, so the viability of using it depends on your threat model.
The key should be an integer from 1 to 1024. The shift is done by character code instead of alphabetically to ensure compatibility with any language.
algorithm.nochatreports.caesar.name: Caesar
chat.nochatreports.disabled.signing_requ: The server refused to deliver an unsigned message. You can enable chat signing by changing your signing mode or through a prompt screen.
disconnect.nochatreports.client: Ваши текущие настройки требуют наличия No Chat Reports на сервере, однако здесь этот мод отсутствует.
gui.NoChatReports.showEncryptionButtonWa: §cBelow does not disable encryption, it only hides the button!
gui.nochatreports.encryption_config.dice: Generate a new random key with respect to the selected encryption algorithm.
gui.nochatreports.encryption_config.head: Encryption Settings
gui.nochatreports.encryption_config.key_:
§lEncryption Key§r
Key that will be used to encrypt and decrypt your messages. Its format depends on the algorithm; for AES it will be 128 bits of Base64-encoded binary data.
gui.nochatreports.encryption_config.pass:
§lEncryption Passphrase§r
Instead of generating a random key, you can derive one from a passphrase of your choice. If you use this - choose a strong one. Not all algorithms support passphrases.
gui.nochatreports.encryption_tooltip:
§lEncryption:§r %1$s
Right-click to configure.

While encryption is enabled, you can prevent it from being applied to the message by holding %2$s when sending it.
gui.nochatreports.encryption_warning.con:
You can encrypt your messages using a secret key. Only people who know this key will be able to decrypt them. No Chat Reports will automatically decrypt all encrypted messages when a suitable key is provided and the feature is enabled.
However, be aware that encryption is not a "magic wand" kind of solution. Moderators on third-party servers can mute or ban you for sending what will appear to them as a garbled mess in chat. Futhermore, it is recommended that you generate a custom encryption key and communicate it to other people only via secure channels. Click "Learn More" to learn more about how and when you should use encryption.
gui.nochatreports.ncr_toggle_tooltip:
§lNo Chat Reports:§r %1$s
Переключение большей части клиентского функционала мода. Это может быть необходимо для игры на серверах с Paper/Velocity, так как они известны своими проблемами с NCR.
Некоторые несвязанные с сетевым взаимодействием функции, такие как "удаление запугивающих уведомлений", всё ещё могут работать и быть настроены индивидуально.
gui.nochatreports.no_reporting: No Chat Reports защищает этот сервер от отправки жалоб.
gui.nochatreports.realms_warning.content: Realms servers are not private. Realm owners cannot disable chat reporting and Mojang employs additional chat monitoring to identify potential "online harms" and escalate them to human review. If you are then found to violate Minecraft's Community Standards - even if the chat participants did not get offended - you will be banned, temporarily or permanently, from all multiplayer services. Usage of encryption is highly advised.
gui.nochatreports.reload_config_tooltip: Перезагрузить настройки No Chat Reports. Используйте с осторожностью.
gui.nochatreports.safety_status.insecure: This server currently demands all chat messages to be signed. All signed messages are a potentially incriminating evidence that can be used against you in a chat report.
You have enabled chat signing, which makes all your messages a potentially incriminating evidence that can be used against you in a chat report.
gui.nochatreports.safety_status.realms: This is a Realms server. Not only is there no way to prevent chat reports here, but Mojang also employs automated chat monitoring to identify potential "online harms" and escalate them to human review, whether the owner of the Realm likes it or not. Your only hope is chat encryption.
gui.nochatreports.safety_status.secure: Сервер либо содержит No Chat Reports, либо предотвращает возможность отправки жалоб иным известным способом. Вы можете общаться безопасно.
gui.nochatreports.safety_status.singlepl: You can always chat safely in singleplayer and self-hosted LAN worlds.
gui.nochatreports.safety_status.undefine: No Chat Reports не смог оценить безопасность этого сервера. Такого быть не должно. Пожалуйста, сообщите разработчику мода об этой ошибке.
gui.nochatreports.safety_status.unintrus: This server allows you to send unsigned messages which cannot be reported to Mojang. Unless some kind of plugin is installed on the server that prevents chat reports - vanilla clients will still send signed messages, display unsigned messages as "Unverified" and not show them if "Only Show Secure Chat" is enabled in chat options.
gui.nochatreports.safety_status.unknown: No Chat Reports is not sure about safety of this server yet. Try sending a message in chat in order to evaluate it.
gui.nochatreports.safety_status_button.c: Left-click to cycle between signing modes.
gui.nochatreports.secure_chat: Этот параметр не работает с No Chat Reports ввиду отсутствия криптографических подписей.
gui.nochatreports.signing_mode.always.to: This mode automatically enables message signing as soon as you enter the server, identically to how a vanilla client would.
gui.nochatreports.signing_mode.never.too: In this mode, messages are never signed and all server requests to sign them are ignored.
gui.nochatreports.signing_mode.never_for: This mode indicates that your messages cannot be signed at all, either because you are using an offline account or because the client failed to fetch your signing keys from Mojang's service.
gui.nochatreports.signing_mode.on_demand: Similar to prompt mode, but instead of showing a pop-up screen, signing will just be enabled automatically as soon as the server demands it.
gui.nochatreports.signing_mode.prompt.to: In this mode, messages are not signed by default, but if the server demands signing, you will be shown a pop-up screen where you can enable signing for one session.
gui.nochatreports.signing_required.check: Don't show again during this session
gui.nochatreports.signing_required.conte:
This server requires all chat messages to be signed, which means they can be reported to Mojang, which may result in a ban from all multiplayer servers. This likely means that the server owner kept "enforce-secure-profile" enabled in the server.properties, which is the default since 1.19.1.

Click "Allow Signing" to enable message signing for this session. You can also use the safety status button in the chat screen to select the signing mode for this server.
gui.nochatreports.signing_status.allowed: Message signing is enabled for this session.
Chat signing is always enabled on Realms, since it is always required and disabling it would yield no benefit anyways.
Message signing is enabled for this session, but it will be disabled once you re-join.
gui.nochatreports.signing_status.disable: Message signing is disabled for this session.
Message signing is disabled for this session, but it will be enabled once you send any message.
Message signing is disabled since this is an offline server.
gui.nochatreports.verified_server:
§a§lБезопасный сервер§r
Было обнаружено, что сервер либо содержит No Chat Reports, либо предотвращает возможность отправки жалоб иным известным способом. Здесь можно общаться безопасно.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.nochatrep: Удаляет криптографические подписи у сообщений игроков, из-за чего их отслеживание и сопоставление с вашим аккаунтом Mojang/Microsoft становится невозможным, ровно как и использование функции жалобы.
nochatreports.connect.nokey_rejected: The server rejected the connection without a chat signing key.
option.NoChatReports.addQueryData.toolti: Разрешить серверу отправлять дополнительные данные игрокам при попытке установки связи. Это используется для отображения метки "Безопасный сервер" (и других технических целей).
option.NoChatReports.alwaysHideReportBut: Предотвратить даже отображение кнопки жалобы игроку на экране социальных взаимодействий. Отключено по умолчанию - мод просто делает кнопку неактивной на серверах с No Chat Reports, добавляя к ней подсказку с объяснением.
option.NoChatReports.convertToGameMessag: Каждое сообщение от игроков будет отправлено таким образом, чтобы оно считалось системным. Системные сообщения сервера не содержат подписи и не могут быть выбраны для отправки жалобы. На немодифицированных клиентах сохраняется серая пометка слева от сообщения.
Sets the signing mode default for servers that force or allow chat signing.
option.NoChatReports.demandOnClient.tool: Заставить внутренний сервер при открытии требовать установки No Chat Reports у подключающихся игроков.
option.NoChatReports.demandOnClientMessa: The message that is displayed to a client if it tries to join the server without having No Chat Reports installed.
option.NoChatReports.demandOnServer.tool: Защитить игрока от присоединения к серверам без No Chat Reports.
option.NoChatReports.disableTelemetry.to: Отключить встроенный в игру сбор телеметрии, как это делает мод No Telemetry.
option.NoChatReports.enableDebugLog.tool: Включить ведение записей с некоторой отладочной информацией. Зачастую это бесполезно для обычных пользователей.
option.NoChatReports.enableMod.tooltip: Ручное переключение большей части функций мода на стороне клиента.
option.NoChatReports.hideInsecureMessage: Prevents the client from displaying unverified message indicators in the form of a gray bar to the left of the chat message.
option.NoChatReports.hideModifiedMessage: Prevents the client from displaying modified message indicators in the form of a gray bar to the left and §7§l(§r§7?§7§l)§r on hover to the right of the chat message.
option.NoChatReports.hideSigningRequestM: Hides the chat message that is shown when the server requests the client to sign messages.
option.NoChatReports.hideSystemMessageIn: Prevents the client from displaying system message indicators in the form of a gray bar to the left of the chat message.
option.NoChatReports.hideWarningToast.to: Удалять запугивающие уведомления, которые появляются каждый раз при присоединении к серверу с отключёным §oenforce-secure-profile§r.
option.NoChatReports.showEncryptionButto: Setting this to false will simply prevent the encryption button from being displayed in the chat screen. Be aware that encryption itself will not be automatically disabled along with the button.
option.NoChatReports.showEncryptionIndic: Toggles the display of the encrypted message indicators in the form of a purple bar to the left and §5§l(§r§5ȯ§5§l)§r on hover to the right of the chat message.
option.NoChatReports.showNCRButton.toolt: Добавить на экран сетевой игры кнопку для переключения большинства клиентских функций мода.
option.NoChatReports.showReloadButton.to: Добавить на экран сетевой игры кнопку для перезагрузки настроек из файлов конфигурации.
option.NoChatReports.showServerSafety.mo: §bНажмите, чтобы узнать больше об уровнях безопасности серверов
option.NoChatReports.showServerSafety.to: Отображать в правом нижнем углу значок статуса безопасности сервера при открытии чата. Значок содержит дополнительную информацию в подсказке.
option.NoChatReports.verifiedIconEnabled: Помечать особым значком в меню сетевой игры серверы, установившие No Chat Reports или другие блокирующие жалобы инструменты.
option.NoChatReports.verifiedIconOffsetX: Установить смещение метки "Безопасный сервер" по оси X.
option.NoChatReports.verifiedIconOffsetY: Установить смещение метки "Безопасный сервер" по оси Y.
